title: Learning Management System (LMS)
description: A comprehensive LMS for universities to host courses, manage assignments, and track student grades. Features video hosting and plagiarism detection.

modules.name: Course Delivery
modules.description: Structured modules with video streaming, PDFs, and interactive quizzes.

modules.name: Assignment & Grading
modules.description: Submission portals with rubrics, inline grading, and gradebook calculation.

modules.name: Plagiarism Checker Integration
modules.description: Automated submission of documents to Turnitin or similar APIs.

modules.name: Discussion Forums
modules.description: Threaded discussions for students and TAs.

project_objectives: Ensure high availability during exam periods

title: Interactive Coding Bootcamp Platform
description: An online platform where students can write, execute, and test code directly in the browser with real-time feedback.

modules.name: In-Browser Code Editor
modules.description: Monaco editor integration with syntax highlighting and auto-complete.

modules.name: Code Execution Engine
modules.description: Secure, sandboxed execution of user code using Docker containers.

modules.name: Automated Testing
modules.description: Running student code against hidden test cases and returning results.

modules.name: Progress Tracking
modules.description: Gamified dashboard showing completed challenges and skill trees.

project_objectives: Execute user code within 2 seconds securely
Prevent malicious code from affecting the host server

title: Student Information System (SIS)
description: A centralized database system for managing student records, attendance, timetables, and parent communications.

modules.name: Demographics & Records
modules.description: Managing student personal information, medical records, and disciplinary history.

modules.name: Timetabling
modules.description: Algorithm to generate conflict-free class schedules for teachers and students.

modules.name: Attendance Tracking
modules.description: Daily and period-based attendance logging with automated alerts for absentees.

modules.name: Parent Portal
modules.description: Secure login for parents to view grades, attendance, and communicate with teachers.

project_objectives: Generate a school-wide timetable without conflicts

title: Language Learning App
description: A gamified mobile application for learning new languages using spaced repetition systems (SRS) and voice recognition.

modules.name: Spaced Repetition Engine
modules.description: Algorithm to schedule vocabulary reviews based on user performance.

modules.name: Speech Evaluation
modules.description: Using speech-to-text to evaluate user pronunciation accuracy.

modules.name: Gamification System
modules.description: Points, streaks, leaderboards, and achievement badges.

modules.name: Content Management
modules.description: Admin panel for linguists to add new languages and lessons.

title: Virtual Classroom & Whiteboard
description: A real-time collaborative platform for 1-on-1 and small group tutoring, featuring a shared interactive whiteboard and audio/video.

modules.name: Interactive Whiteboard
modules.description: Canvas for drawing, adding text, and shapes synced in real-time across all users.

modules.name: Document Annotation
modules.description: Uploading PDFs and allowing users to draw over them collaboratively.

modules.name: A/V Conferencing
modules.description: Integrated video calling alongside the whiteboard.

modules.name: Session Recording
modules.description: Recording the canvas actions and audio for playback later.

project_objectives: Support smooth rendering of complex annotations
